briefing.text: The hypothesis needs a community-level income variable (e.g. census-tract or zip median income, SES, deprivation index such as ADI). Before any modelling, search every column header and every '#' description line in data_clinical_patient.txt and data_clinical_sample.txt (and the other files) for income, SES, zip, census, tract, deprivation, ADI, ancestry, admixture. A library header scan found only RACE (White/Black/Asian) and no income or ancestry column; verify this yourself. Do not substitute a proxy (race, smoking, PSA, disease extent, sample type) for income; if no income variable exists, the relationship cannot be tested from these data.
briefing.reason: The main risk is that a team tests a proxy exposure and reports True/False on a hypothesis whose exposure may not be in the data.

briefing.text: Self-reported race is not genetic ancestry; ancestry is usually inferred from germline SNPs (e.g. EUR/AFR/EAS fractions). Look for an ancestry column; the library's scan saw none. If it is absent, do not claim ancestry-adjusted results and do not let RACE stand in for both covariates.
briefing.reason: The hypothesis requires adjustment for both race and ancestry; teams could wrongly report ancestry-adjusted results.

briefing.text: 8q status is in data_clinical_sample.txt column 8Q_ARM with values Gain/Neutral/Loss and 'Not called' (about 120 samples). Drop 'Not called' rather than treating it as Neutral, keep one sample per patient (e.g. first or primary), and include sample type (primary vs metastatic) as a covariate, because 8q gain is enriched in metastases.
briefing.reason: Correct outcome coding and patient-level de-duplication matter for any 8q analysis the team runs.

briefing.text: If an area-level income variable does exist, treat it as an ecological measure confounded by race, disease stage, sample type and referral pattern. Fit a logistic regression of 8q gain on income plus race, ancestry (if available), sample type and disease extent, and report the adjusted estimate with its CI rather than the crude association. Minority groups are small (Black n=165, Asian n=63 of about 2069 patients), so a null adjusted result with a wide CI is weak evidence against an association.
briefing.reason: This only applies if the exposure is present, but it sets out the adjustment and how to read a null result.

shared_assumptions: Both teams assumed that without a recorded community-income variable the hypothesis cannot be tested, and that no geographic or socioeconomic field (zip code, county, insurance) could stand in for it. Neither fitted any model. The director's own header check agrees: the patient table has only age, race, smoking, PSA, M stage, vital status and disease extent.

Both treated RACE (White/Black/Asian) as the only usable covariate and agreed that genetic ancestry is missing. Neither considered whether ancestry could be derived from the data; with tumour-normal somatic calls only, it cannot.
unused_evidence: data_cna_hg19.seg and data_cna.txt could give an independent 8q call, but they bear only on the outcome, not the missing exposure, so they cannot change the label.

The 120 'Not called' 8Q_ARM samples and the extra columns in data_mutations.txt and data_sv.txt (no income, ancestry or population fields found by the director's grep) are irrelevant to whether the exposure exists.
unresolved_weak_points: Both teams named an income measure hidden under an unexpected column name as their weakest point. Both mitigated it by reading every clinical column, and the director's independent read of all 9 patient and 14 sample columns confirms nothing like it exists. This is resolved.
second_readings: A reader could take 'community-level average income' to allow a proxy such as disease extent or smoking. That is not a reasonable stand-in for area-level income, and the task's own example says a missing variable means Not verifiable. No second reading changes the label.
challenge.verdict: High trust in Not verifiable. The exposure (community income) and the ancestry covariate are absent from every file, which the director confirmed independently, so neither team has a check left that could change the label.
